key.name: style
key.description: "original": Stevia's own dark keys. "glass": the look of the password prompt at startup, glass keys over the blurred wallpaper with wider character keys. High contrast always uses Stevia's high contrast look.

key.name: word-suggestions
key.summary: Word suggestions in every text field
key.description: Suggest words while typing in every text field of purpose "normal", not only where an app asks for them. Hidden and sensitive fields never get suggestions. Off, Stevia's own completion-mode (mobi.phosh.osk) decides.

key.name: forget-learned-words
key.summary: Raised to forget the learned words
key.description: The keyboard learns words typed in fields with suggestions. GNOME Settings removes the learned words and raises this number, so a running keyboard forgets them too.
